name: Musco Sports Lighting, LLC
old_description: Since 2023, Bullitt County Public Schools has standardized the lighting performance across its athletic facilities at North, Central, and East High Schools. They’ve invested in Musco LED systems for football, baseball, softball, and tennis, with tailored solutions for new installations and retrofit applications. Additionally, each football stadium now features color-changing luminaires and Show-Light® entertainment technology.
about:
Musco Sports Lighting, LLC is headquartered in Oskaloosa, Iowa. For over half a century, the company has developed sports and large-area lighting systems, growing from its Iowa roots into a global provider of facility solutions.

The company designs and manufactures LED lighting systems for sports venues and large-area applications. Its product portfolio includes the Light-Structure System™, 5 Easy Pieces™ packaged solutions, Mini-Pitch System™ modular fields, Show-Light® color-changing luminaires with entertainment technology, and the Control-Link® remote monitoring and control service. Musco provides custom design, project management, installation support, and 24/7 proactive system monitoring through a team of more than 2,100 employees worldwide.

Musco serves K-12 school districts such as Bullitt County Public Schools, universities including the University of Idaho, municipal parks departments like Windsor Parks and Recreation in Colorado, professional sports organizations including Blackpool FC in England and the Gaelic Athletic Association at Croke Park in Ireland, and international venues such as Mission Whitten Oval in Australia. The company was also named the Official Sport Presentation and Broadcast Lighting Provider for the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Musco emphasizes responsible lighting that minimizes spill light and glare, citing DarkSky certification achievements on projects. Its founding principle centers on existing for the benefit of the team, which the company says drives long-tenured careers and a focus on making high-performance lighting affordable while expanding recreational opportunities in communities.
